test_GTestEnvVarTest_testEnvVarAffectsFl: test that environment variables like GTEST_BREAK_ON_FAILURE affect the corresponding GTest flags
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFile: test that the XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable sets the GTest output flag to xml format
test_GTestEnvVarTest_testXmlOutputFileOv: test that GTEST_OUTPUT environment variable overrides the XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable for output
run_SetEnvVar: set or unset an environment variable in the test environment dictionary by name and value
run_GetFlag: run the googletest-env-var-test executable with a flag argument and return its output
